method.selection: Five representative tasks where the original Private DS quality score was below Online DS, one from each requested capability area.
method.candidate_execution: Only Private DS thinking-on was rerun. Original Private DS and Online DS artifacts were reused.
method.sandbox: One isolated Git worktree per Claude Code attempt with local tools only and no network.

tasks.title: Debug incremental NDJSON decoding
tasks.judge_rationale: Online DS correctly implemented all requested behaviors and had the strongest focused regression coverage. The thinking-on Private DS implementation was correct but omitted several incremental edge cases in its tests.

tasks.title: Rank normalized rotated-log errors
tasks.judge_rationale: Online DS provided the most complete executable and deterministic implementation. Thinking-on Private DS was broadly functional but had normalization, locale, and JSON escaping weaknesses.

tasks.title: Bound a synthetic cgroup OOM incident
tasks.judge_rationale: Online DS best satisfied the requested controls while separating observations from uncertain causes. Thinking-on Private DS was cautious but retained an overly loose memory limit and misplaced restart-limit directives.

tasks.title: Write a cache-pool incident review
tasks.judge_rationale: Online DS had the best structure and factual coverage, although it still added an unsupported no-data-loss statement. The two Private DS answers introduced more unsupported claims or omitted required facts.

tasks.title: Implement an LRU cache with TTL
tasks.judge_rationale: Online DS maintained explicit constant-time recency state and handled expiration most consistently. Both Private DS variants retained observable TTL or deletion edge-case defects.

limitations: Each treatment has one sample per task, so the result is directional rather than statistically significant.
Original Private DS and Online DS outputs were reused while only Private DS thinking-on was rerun.
The Patch4 runtime image and model weights are not distributed in this repository.
